Shadow workflow route key: analytics. Executive SUM(net_sales) from gold.mart_executive_daily (saved chart 1) rose from 2,158,994.74 in July to 2,292,267.50 in August (+133,272.76; +6.17%). Online added 61,949.94 (+7.92%), 46.48% of the increase; Store added 4,394.84, Marketplace 18,701.69 and Mobile 48,226.29. August was +6.47% versus the April–July mean. This complete-month change is below the 10% investigate threshold.

Daily detail (chart 10) ends on September 19; under the supplied steward declaration, September is partial. Separately, September 1–19 versus August 1–19 fell 34,428.19 (−2.45%), with Online down 27,640.19 (−5.40%). This matched-day diagnostic is not the calendar-month policy comparison and does not establish cause.

The card judge preferred insufficient_data (support 0.47), below the 0.70 threshold, so its workflow used the investigation fallback to Analytics; it returned 0 observations and 0 computed analyses. Values are net_sales units; currency is unspecified. Saved-query metadata does not establish warehouse completeness or freshness, while the coverage-through-September-19 statement is owner supplied. Source: analysis_publication|report:northstar-sales (charts 1 and 10). Next check: have Data Trust verify that coverage boundary and rerun the calendar-month comparison once September 30 coverage is established.

Data Trust — insufficient data for the latest calendar-month check. Executive Command Center Revenue trend (chart 1: monthly SUM(net_sales) by channel) and Executive daily detail (chart 10, gold.mart_executive_daily) show the latest observed order_date is 2026-09-19. The steward declares daily detail complete through that date, so September is partial; the saved query still marks warehouse completeness unknown. Do not treat Sep vs Aug as a decline. The last comparable full months were Aug 2,292,267.50 vs Jul 2,158,994.74 (+133,272.76; +6.17%), below the 10% Analytics threshold. Online rose 61,949.94 (+7.92%), contributing 46.48% of that increase. As context, Aug was +6.47% vs the Apr–Jul average of 2,152,978.07. Separate matched-day diagnostic (Sep 1–19 vs Aug 1–19): total net_sales fell 34,428.19 (-2.45%); Online fell 27,640.19 (-5.40%), 80.28% of the net decline, while Store rose 15,948.77. These are channel contributions, not causes; the source defines net_sales as Executive management sales and does not state a currency. Next check: rerun the full-month comparison once Sep 30 is covered, and compare Online sessions/conversion for Sep 1–19 vs Aug 1–19 to investigate the matched-day decrease.
